releases.title: Reliable chat approvals and Office plugin updates
releases.summary: Chat approvals recover from invalid tool inputs. LAB includes the DocsX update and offers SpreadX 0.1.5.
highlights: A malformed tool request cannot block the approval list for valid requests.
Update DocsX from Plugins to preserve headings, lists and tables when creating documents from Markdown.
SpreadX 0.1.5 includes the five-sheet Product Manufacturing Master.
Fresh profiles receive the Office and BOM skills, with existing skill edits preserved.

releases.title: Thinner Frame and DocsX headers and better chat recovery
releases.summary: Frame and DocsX leave more room for your work, and long chats recover more reliably when a model reaches its context limit.
highlights: Frame now puts its layout controls on one row and combines screen controls with the active tab.
The DocsX document title bar is thinner, giving more space to the editor.
Saved chats keep their original attachments and tool results during recovery.
Long tool-using chats can recover from repeated overflows as work progresses.

releases.title: Microphone dictation in chat
releases.summary: Dictate into a chat draft, edit it during transcription, and send it when you are ready.
highlights: Choose Dictate, speak, then choose Stop dictation to append your words to the current draft.
If transcription fails or returns no speech, your existing draft and edits stay in the composer.
Cancelling a recording releases the microphone. Changing chats discards a late transcript.
Use the engine in Audio settings or save a device transcription endpoint under Models.

releases.title: Chat, Brain and Office reliability improvements
releases.summary: LAB keeps unconfirmed chat drafts, recovers interrupted Brain saves, and preserves concurrent settings changes.
highlights: Chat keeps unsaved input when a local service is unavailable.
Brain recovers interrupted saves and preserves edits to the bundled manufacturing skill at startup.
Concurrent changes to different project settings are kept.
Stopping a tool or worker cleans up its pending calls and approvals.
SpreadX preserves formula values with embedded images. DocsX can finish image-based PDF exports.
Smart View keeps update controls inside the window.

releases.title: Reliable exports and downloads in nested Windows folders
releases.summary: LAB handles long Windows paths in Research exports and Automation browser downloads.
highlights: Research dossiers can package and clean up nested evidence files.
Automation workers can open their browsers and save downloads under deeply nested profiles.
Available as a signed Windows x64 update through LAB and the existing universal Setup.

releases.title: One startup and sign-in screen
releases.summary: LAB uses the existing branded loading screen during local startup and sign-in checks.
highlights: App preparation and service verification update the same loading screen.
The same screen stays visible until the workspace or sign-in page is ready.
Available as a signed Windows x64 update through LAB and the existing universal Setup.

releases.title: Smart View window controls
releases.summary: Smart View accepts clicks after the pointer returns and has a native Minimize button.
highlights: Click the panel normally after moving the pointer away and back.
Minimize and restore Smart View, then use Return to chat to reopen the full workspace.
Available as a signed Windows x64 update through LAB and the existing universal Setup.

releases.title: In-app update progress
releases.summary: SKS LAB shows download, verification and installation progress during an in-app update.
highlights: See the download percentage and application file preparation as Setup runs.
Restart to update appears when Setup finishes. Unsuccessful attempts give you a retry option.
Available as a signed Windows x64 update through LAB and the existing universal Setup.

releases.title: Company model settings sync
releases.summary: SKS LAB refreshes company-managed model settings after changes on the SKS website.
highlights: See the effective company image, video, audio, 3D and vision models in LAB settings.
Company settings refresh while LAB is open and honor the company override policy.
Available as a signed Windows x64 update through LAB and the existing universal Setup.

releases.title: Chat layout and input recovery
releases.summary: Chat layout, model picker and company input recovery fixes. Available through the universal installer and in-app updates.
highlights: Fixed chat overflow beside Frame and model picker layering and provider labels.
Automatically compact company requests before the gateway input allowance and recover from input-size rejections.
The existing universal installer and in-app updater automatically select this release.

releases.title: Chat layout and input recovery
releases.summary: Chat layout, model picker and company input recovery fixes. Available through the universal installer and in-app updates.
highlights: Fixed chat overflow beside Frame and model picker layering and provider labels.
Automatically compact company requests before the gateway input allowance and recover from input-size rejections.
The existing universal installer and in-app updater automatically select this release.

releases.title: Compact chat header and Windows installer
releases.summary: A thinner chat header and a downloadable Windows installer. Windows may show an Unknown publisher or SmartScreen warning for this unsigned installer.
highlights: Reduced chat header height while keeping readable text and all controls.
Reinstall bundled StudioX and MeshX after removal while keeping saved plugin data.
Windows installer downloads the latest compatible version and checks its signed feed and archive checksum.

releases.title: Chat Enhance and Windows update
releases.summary: Stable Windows x64 installations can update in the app. The Windows setup download is still pending publisher verification.
highlights: Enhance rewrites the chat draft using the configured small model. It preserves edits while a rewrite is running.
Existing stable Windows x64 installations can open Settings → System → Check for updates.

releases.title: The rebuilt LAB foundation
releases.summary: SKS LAB 1.0.0 brings the prepared Sera foundation into the main LAB product with its original identity. This is a source release. Public Windows installers are pending publisher verification and are not available for this version. Retired beta installers are not offered as 1.0.0.
highlights: Keep the original LAB logo while bringing together chat, Brain, settings, effort controls, Frame and workspace planning from the prepared foundation.
Retain LAB Social and plugin capabilities, with company model defaults and separate plugin provider settings.
Use the SKSSI account, company-provider and credit bridge with per-application access controls.
Preserve existing LAB preview work and verify updates before activating a new managed version.
The original Sera/Joy reference remains unchanged. Windows installer publication requires a verified publisher identity.

releases.title: Independent MeshX and StudioX apps
releases.summary: MeshX and StudioX now install and launch as separate applications from SKS LAB. Their versions come from their own app releases, while AI tools remain available after installation. The old embedded screens are removed.
highlights: Install, update, and launch MeshX and StudioX from Plugins as independent applications.
Use their AI tools in LAB after the corresponding application is installed and enabled.
Keep plugin versions separate from the LAB version.
Remove the old embedded MeshX and StudioX screens.

releases.title: Boxed chat replies and live plugin control
releases.summary: Assistant replies now sit in a clean glass card, and chat tools can control installed plugin applications through each app's own versioned local API.
highlights: Read assistant answers and tool activity inside a tidy card instead of raw text on the thread background.
Let chat call DocsX, SLIDEX, SpreadX, and Tabiix through each installed app's own local API and version.
Expose only the plugin actions the installed app version actually implements.
Finish media turns after an image, video, audio, or 3D result instead of reporting an incomplete draft.
Keep plugin data, migrations, and versions owned by the plugin applications.
Preserve existing themes, user bubbles, saved data, and company capabilities.

releases.title: Reliable update download and install
releases.summary: Updates now download as a versioned application package, show a clear preparing-and-verifying state after reaching 100 percent, and can retry instead of sitting on a frozen download screen.
highlights: See a Preparing update state while the downloaded package is verified and prepared.
Download a package whose name is unique to the release, avoiding stale fixed-package delivery.
Get a clear retry action if the downloaded update cannot be prepared.
Keep the existing single fixed Windows web installer for new installs.
See fresh built-in studios as available and Download them before opening them.
Keep the version and update controls in Settings, System.
Preserve Company, plugin, and saved data behavior.

releases.title: Glassy Company workspace and connected studios
releases.summary: The Company workspace now uses the Glassy Light material system, and MeshX and StudioX open inside SKS LAB with the company MuAPI connection instead of asking for personal keys.
highlights: Use a translucent glass topbar, hero, company switcher, office toolbar, conversation, departments, jobs, and company-creation surfaces.
Keep the dark 3D office as the focal artwork while the surrounding workspace matches the rest of the app.
Open MeshX and StudioX inside SKS LAB with the Company API connection and their tool sets available.
Use the Plugins page to download managed plugin versions and check for updates.
Keep the existing version, update, and Settings → System behavior.

releases.title: System settings and one Windows installer
releases.summary: Version and update controls now live in Settings, System. Updates are checked automatically but downloaded and installed only when you choose, with a progress screen and a clear restart step. Windows now uses one small web installer that downloads the latest application package.
highlights: See the installed version, available version, last check, and update status in Settings, System.
Check for updates manually or let the automatic check notify you once per new version.
Download only when you choose, follow the percentage in the upgrade screen, then restart and install.
See an in-app banner for available and ready updates without losing the Settings status.
Use one Windows web installer for every release; it installs the latest application package at install time.
Replace an existing SKS LAB installation with a confirmation prompt while keeping settings and data.
Keep LAB capabilities, product identity, saved data, and the existing update channel.

releases.title: Independent plugin library and role access
releases.summary: SKS LAB now installs, updates, and launches its plugin applications from an independent library. Administrators can limit which plugins appear for each staff role.
highlights: Install, update, and remove plugin applications without replacing SKS LAB.
Open MeshX, StudioX, SLIDEX, SpreadX, DocsX, and Tabiix as independent applications.
Use versioned managed installs with SHA-256 verified Windows packages and rollback.
See an in-app notice when a newer plugin release is available, then update manually.
Hide plugin applications that the signed-in staff role is not allowed to use.
Keep existing source-folder installs available while managed installs are adopted.
Preserve LAB identity, saved data, company capabilities, and the existing update channel.

releases.title: Independent plugin library and role access
releases.summary: SKS LAB now installs, updates, and launches its plugin applications from an independent library. Administrators can limit which plugins appear for each staff role.
highlights: Install, update, and remove plugin applications without replacing SKS LAB.
Open MeshX, StudioX, SLIDEX, SpreadX, DocsX, and Tabiix as independent applications.
Use versioned managed installs with SHA-256 verified Windows packages and rollback.
See an in-app notice when a newer plugin release is available, then update manually.
Hide plugin applications that the signed-in staff role is not allowed to use.
Keep existing source-folder installs available while managed installs are adopted.
Preserve LAB identity, saved data, company capabilities, and the existing update channel.

releases.title: A Windows installer that launches.
releases.summary: The Windows installer now opens the branded SKS Lab desktop app instead of exiting at startup, and the installed shortcut launches the app directly.
highlights: Launch the installed SKS Lab app from its own desktop and Start Menu shortcut.
Show the SKS Lab icon and version in the installed executable instead of Electron defaults.
Align the packaged asar integrity fuse with the Windows build so the app no longer exits at startup.
Keep the 0.1.20 workspace, company media and specialist runtime capabilities.
The installer remains unsigned; Windows Smart App Control may block it until the app is trusted or the policy is off.

releases.title: Reliable company media and cleaner plugin boundaries
releases.summary: Company media jobs, specialist runtimes, chat controls and plugin boundaries are more reliable while LAB retains its complete workspace capabilities.
highlights: Route chat media through approved company jobs with clearer previews and dependable specialist runtime support.
Keep the chat mode selector readable over conversation content.
Separate Cookbook from the desktop runtime and remove its stale web client and automatic discovery path.
Preserve FlowX exclusions, product identity and LAB's Company, Social and Deep Research capabilities.

releases.title: Connected creative tools and company defaults
releases.summary: Updated creative studios, CAD workflows, company model defaults, Frame and chat behavior in the current desktop workspace.
highlights: Use the original StudioX and MeshX interfaces through approved company MuAPI models.
Follow affordable company specialist defaults with ordered fallbacks and reset controls.
Use updated chat, speech, CAD, Materials and automatic Frame sizing.
Keep the latest Company, Social and Deep Research tools in LAB.
Include current source support and WhatsApp connection fixes.

releases.title: LAB StudioX Workflow source update
releases.summary: StudioX Workflow consolidates the workflow entry while retaining the shared FlowX engine. Version remains 0.1.18. Source update only: the existing version and tag are unchanged. No new installers; existing downloads retain their published versions.
highlights: Open workflows from StudioX; the duplicate FlowX launcher and plugin library entry have been removed.
Import built-in templates and earlier FlowX canvases as separate StudioX copies, preserving original canvases.
Use the shared workflow tools and image, video, audio and 3D model categories. Shared engine, Brain tools and backend compatibility routes remain available.
Use the FlowX-based workflow canvas within StudioX, with separate saved StudioX workflows and image, video, audio and 3D media support.
Use improved MeshX local processing and company-connected StudioX agent creation.
Use improved chat replies, attachments, follow-up handling, endpoint selection and CAD/Design tools while retaining LAB capabilities.
Choose Design from the premium mode selector and retain its design workflow.
Keep a single companion visible when switching modes.
See the application name beside the mini companion in compact window mode.

releases.title: Simple actions that follow through.
releases.summary: Chat takes simple authorized actions directly and confirms completion after tool use. Source/version notes only; no new installers. Existing downloads retain their published versions.
highlights: Make authorized browser opening available immediately for simple chat requests.
Skip unnecessary introductory planning and discovery when the required action is already available.
Confirm completion after tool calls and bound consecutive unconfirmed replies instead of stopping after progress text.

releases.title: A clearer Smart View.
releases.summary: Smart View uses readable mode choices, stronger contrast and a cleaner layout. Source/version notes only; no new installers. Existing downloads retain their published versions.
highlights: Choose Ask, Plan and CAD with clear icons and descriptions instead of repeated characters.
Keep the companion hidden in Ask, Plan and CAD while retaining the Orchestrate greeting.
Use improved spacing, contrast, keyboard focus and descriptive toolbar labels.

releases.title: Keep action requests moving.
releases.summary: SERA continues website-opening requests after an introductory reply and confirms when a turn is complete. Source/version notes only; no new installers. Existing downloads retain their published versions.
highlights: Continue an action request after a progress message instead of treating the message as completed work.
Confirm a final answer explicitly while keeping greetings and answers from context direct.
Show a clear blocked outcome when the model repeatedly fails to act or confirm completion.

releases.title: Window mode restored. SKS SI Beta.
releases.summary: The compact top-right Frame preview returns in the installed desktop app, with SKS SI startup branding and a clear Beta label.
highlights: Switch Frame into Window mode for a small floating preview at the top-right of your workspace.
Expand the same screen back beside Chat without reloading the editor or losing its layout and pane width.
Remember Window mode after reload; passive previews capture only the selected screen and never resize the native application.
See SKS SI branding and Beta version information during both native startup and the sign-in check.
Identify the Beta release in the app header, sign-in screen and Settings information page while keeping automatic updates enabled.

releases.title: A clearer plugin library. Your account in view.
releases.summary: A refreshed Plugins page, verified account photos and consistent provider and model artwork throughout the desk.
highlights: Browse a cleaner plugin library with search, status filters, working controls and real editor previews inside the cards.
Use a text-led Plugins header and a native toolbar without decorative banner images.
Show your verified Google account photo in the toolbar, sidebar and account settings, with initials if the photo is unavailable.
See provider and model logos in catalogs, model details and company models, with clear provider artwork when a model has no individual image.
Cloud-app availability still depends on vendor approval; this release does not enable public Google or Figma access.

releases.title: A clearer Workspace. Real app previews.
releases.summary: Fresh geometric identities and actual interface previews for Deep Research, Calendar and Kanban.
highlights: New matching logos for Deep Research, Calendar and Kanban in the Workspace library, sidebar and app headers.
Real application screenshots with labelled sample projects replace the decorative illustrations.
Full 16:9 previews remain visible, with cleaner cards in both light and dark appearances.
Sample previews stay separate from live tasks and schedules on your own desk.
Remove a stale decorative backdrop reference while retaining the live theme effects.

releases.title: Clear application availability.
releases.summary: Canva now shows its development status, with new connection setup paused.
highlights: See Canva marked Under development in Apps and MCP.
New Canva connection attempts stop before browser sign-in.
Existing approved connections retain their Disconnect control.

releases.title: Personal providers. Reliable desktop startup.
releases.summary: Company models remain the default, with the original API and local provider controls available alongside them.
highlights: Fixed Windows startup when installer-only metadata is absent from the packaged app.
Restore self-configured API providers, custom endpoints, and local models after sign-in.
Keep provider discovery, model catalogs, probing, key management, and endpoint cleanup.
Select personal models and specialist fallback chains while keeping company credentials separate.
Retain the refreshed application and plugin logos throughout the workspace.

releases.title: A clearer identity. A more consistent workspace.
releases.summary: A new family of app and plugin marks, paired with real editor previews.
highlights: Refined geometric logos for the app and its included plugins.
Matching identity across startup, desktop icons, workspace headers, and the plugin library.
Real document, spreadsheet, presentation, and creative-canvas previews.
More reliable FlowX canvas access while using managed accounts.
Cookbook Downloads searches the model catalog from the correct tab.

releases.title: A smoother window. A more consistent start.
releases.summary: Refined window behavior and more reliable startup after updates.
highlights: Rounded corners across restored Windows app windows, including sign-in and dialogs.
Window controls stay in sync when maximizing and restoring.
Installed apps consistently open the interface included with their update.

releases.title: A fresh welcome to your workspace.
releases.summary: A redesigned sign-in experience and animated loading screen bring the app’s identity into its first moments.
highlights: Branded floating-logo animation with subtle lighting and motion.
Clearer browser approval and connection recovery screens.
Verified restoration of valid saved sign-ins across restarts.
